rule: After a bug fix or change request is implemented: deploy to DEV first, get approval, only then deploy to PROD. Never skip DEV or approval.

steps.name: Implement fix / change
steps.exit_criteria: Code/report/pipeline change ready to publish to DEV

steps.name: Deploy to DEV
steps.exit_criteria: Change visible on DEV; reconciliation checks can be re-run

steps.name: Await approval for PROD
steps.exit_criteria: FA (or designated approver) confirms DEV results vs spec / expected figures

steps.name: Deploy to PROD
steps.exit_criteria: Change live on PROD; final reconciliation on PROD

forbidden: Deploy fix directly to PROD without DEV
